notes.title: Stone Shelter's journey starts here!
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello dear followers and fans of Stone Shelter![/b][/i]


[b]Let's start with a little statement about us[/b]: Stone Shelter is an italian indie collective made of talented people and gamers of all kinds! We're passionate about our projects and we want to break into the game industry with fun and unique titles.

[b]The response to our Ctrl-U announcement[/b] in October 2023 exceeded our expectations: for that we want to say thanks to every media that covered our announcement and now we have some exciting news to share with you! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708696/124b8be60a150561b670dbcdb63ff97a6c6d62ed.jpg[/img]
[b]Nordic Game in Malmö From May 21st to 24th[/b]
We’ll be in Malmö for the Nordic Game event. This gathering provides us with the opportunity to connect with other developers, publishers, and industry enthusiasts. We hope to make new connections and find a publisher interested in our projects. 
Our Producer/VFX Artist and our Art Director will be there, so let's meet there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708696/d2321babde0ca7561f5f6c34dc9ac8713032550c.png[/img]
[b]Our current financial status [/b]
We’re actively seeking a publisher to support our work. 
However, even without a publisher or funds, we’ll continue developing our games within our free time since we're a collective and each of our member's working on volountary basis. 
Our team’s passion and commitment remain unwavering, and we’re determined to move forward with our projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708696/cd6fea3909c070b98aff738998075ced17048f6e.jpg[/img]
[b]Project Updates[/b] 
This year, we’ll start sharing more details about our games. 
As you can find out from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645010/CTRLU/]CTRL-U store page[/url], we're developing a Sci-fi Parkour game set in a futuristic industrial setting. 

A game that every fan of the parkour genre has to try when it's ready! Why? We might have an interesting twist on that.

Our team is working tirelessly to structure and finalize the basic mechanics of the game. This is a crucial step in ensuring a smooth and engaging gameplay experience. We look forward to share with you the first gameplay elements this year!

We’ll keep you informed about development progress, future plans, and features of our titles, so stay tuned for further updates!

Thank you for your ongoing support ❤️
Stone Shelter is ready for new adventures, and we can’t wait to share them with you!

Now, Run with us 🏃
